# Hi.

<br>
Information about 259 W 31st Street

I'm motivated by challenging problems and a desire to leave the world a little better than I found it. Please send me a <a href="mailto:bmbrost@gmail.com" style="color:#0b66c3; text-decoration: underline" title="Send an email">message</a> if you'd like to work together.
